entity_id.description: A unique temporary ID for this extraction (e.g., e_1)

name.description: The exact, canonical name of the entity, stripping leading articles.

classification_reasoning.description: Briefly explain why this entity fits the chosen type based on the strict rules.

gmDescription.description: Extract the mechanical function, raw stat block text, gold value, rules, or GM-only true nature.

loreContext.description: Extract who made it, historical background, rumors, or cultural significance.

physicalAppearance.description: Extract sensory details: what it looks, sounds, or smells like, or exact text if ReadAloudText.

isPlayerFacing.description: True if players know this immediately, False if it is a GM secret, Trigger, or HiddenInfo.

dcTarget.description: If a check is required, extract ONLY the numeric target value (e.g., 15).
